rev.t: I had such a lovely experience at Sorelle Jewellery. The store has a beautiful vibe and such a stunning selection of pieces — it was honestly hard to choose! Nora was incredibly polite and supportive, taking the time to help me decide on …

Rose and Nora were very kind in showing us the collection.

I walked in picking up accessory for my dear friend birthday present and …

There’s a variety of style within the theme of every day jewelry. I found what I was looking for, thanks to the help of Nora.
Had a pleasant time trying items and shopping. Will definitely be coming here once in a while.
